a.normalization: NFKC, casefold, keep Unicode letters/numbers only
a.development_choice: Fixed 0.60 after inspecting only names/candidate-score ranges in the 3 existing synthetic development tables; no truth-based threshold sweep. Exact/near English names should pass; weak abbreviation overlap should abstain. Korean-English mismatch is a known limitation.

execution.partition: one source column per request for B/C/D; all target candidates; no other source names or row context
execution.input_bound: UTF-8 bytes of system + content + schema, plus framing reserve and output budget; conservative bound, not reported API tokens
execution.on_limit: block B/C/D together before calls for the selected scope; never clip, silently reduce features, or retry with different information

profile.missing: empty or whitespace-only after strip; NA/null text stays a value
profile.analysis_text: strip outer whitespace in a separate analysis copy; original cells unchanged
profile.numeric_inference: 100% nonmissing strict finite decimal, no leading-zero code-like value; integer iff all numeric values have zero fractional part
profile.numeric_encoding: exact decimal strings; quartiles linear interpolation at (n-1)*p
profile.date_inference: 100% nonmissing strict valid YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime; no slash dates, compact dates, epochs or dateutil inference
profile.date_range: parsed subset; aware values normalized to UTC, naive dates at midnight; omit range if aware/naive mixed

pattern_definitions.latin_digit_mixed: ASCII letters/digits only, with at least one of each
pattern_definitions.other: none of the four mutually exclusive patterns above

selection.label: 자료형 기반 선택 프로파일 v0
selection.type_source: profile inferred_type, never a column name or evaluation label

reasons.common: Missingness and auditable inferred type are shared context.
reasons.integer: Central numeric distribution and signs/fractionality, without using names or guessing unit price/total.
reasons.number: Central numeric distribution and signs/fractionality, without using names or guessing unit price/total.
reasons.string: Cardinality, typical length and format patterns; omit raw category strings.
reasons.boolean: Cardinality and lexical patterns; omit category values.
reasons.date: Strict parse coverage, comparable range and time presence.
reasons.unknown: No nonmissing evidence; use common features only.
